blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.
blocks.zh: 我们问驾驶模型用一台相机和实时延迟能达到多大程度. BADS-3.0是一个1B参数的视频编码器,有四个小头. 从一个前置相机的2秒,它预测了当前的速度,刚驱动的公尺路径,碰撞风险分数和6个候选期货超过6.4秒,在50ms以下. 鉴于该车目前的速度,BADS-3.0在5个轨迹基准上比34B Alpamayo 2 Super低44%的minADE$_6美元,后者读取6台相机,运行速度较100x慢. 所得来自两个模型都没有经过训练的摄像机钻机。 在他们共享的钻机上,两者处于平价状态. 现有基准大多是名义驱动,因此我们增加了两个开放式安全基准,一个是真正的短程相机碰撞和近似失速,另一个是欧洲NCAP方案。 两者,BADS-3.0的通过率都高于我们测试的每个公布的计程员.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : BADAS-3.0. A ViT backbone encodes two seconds of footage from one camera and four output heads return the speed, the past ego-pose, the collision risk and six candidate future trajectories.
blocks.zh: 图1: BADS-3.0. 一个ViT主干线编码了1个相机和4个输出头的2秒镜头返回速度,过去自负,碰撞风险和6个候选未来轨迹.

blocks.en: Driving planning models keep getting larger. Recently published systems are typically vision-language-action (VLA) models with several to tens of billions of parameters that read multiple cameras plus ego state or history [ 44 , 48 , 74 , 32 , 73 ] . These models may use long reasoning traces and diffusion or flow matching heads which require a large amount of iterative computation to produce driving trajectories. For example the recently released Alpamayo 2 Super takes 5 s and nearly 80 GiB of memory per two-second input window on an A100 GPU (Table 18 , supplement).
blocks.zh: 驾驶规划模型越来越大。 最近公布的系统一般是视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,有数到数百亿个参数来读取多个相机加上自我状态或历史[44,48,74,32,73]. 这些模型可能使用长推理痕迹和扩散或流配对头,需要大量迭代计算才能产生驱动轨迹. 例如,最近发布的Alpamayo 2 Super在A100 GPU(表18,补编)上每两秒输入窗口就需要5 s和近80 GiB的内存.

blocks.en: We introduce BADAS-3.0, a 1B-parameter video vision transformer (ViT) [ 13 ] taking as input a two-second clip from a single forward-facing camera. The model has four output heads: a trajectory head producing six candidate future trajectories as well as a soft selection score, a speed head regressing the current ego speed, an ego-pose head which predicts the metric path just driven and a risk head predicting the future collision-risk score (Figure 1 ). A single forward pass takes 43 ms and 1.9 GiB of memory (compiled, single A100, batch one).
blocks.zh: 我们引进了BADS-3.0,一台1B参数的视频视变器(ViT)[13],作为输入,从一个单一的前视相机中取出两秒钟的片段. 该模型有四个输出头:一个轨迹头产生六个候选的未来轨迹以及一个软的选择分数,一个速度头递减当前自负速度,一个自负头预测刚驱动的公制路径,一个风险头预测未来碰撞风险分数(图1). 单向前传需要43ms和1.9 GiB的内存(编译,单A100,第1批).

blocks.en: We evaluate BADAS-3.0’s trajectories on five driving benchmarks against several open driving models (Section 4 ). Given the car’s current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE 6 than Alpamayo 2 Super, which has 34 × \times more parameters, reads six cameras and runs over 100 × \times slower (Section 4.2 ). Adding the rest of the ego history improves this by less than 1%. With no speed input at all, BADAS-3.0 uses its own speed estimate. Calibrating that estimate on ten examples recovers most of the lost accuracy. BADAS-3.0’s mean error is then below every baseline’s, even though the baselines get the full ego history.
blocks.zh: 我们评价BADS-3.0在五个驾驶基准上的轨迹, 鉴于该车目前的速度,BADS-3.0比Alpamayo 2 Super低44%的分钟ADE 6,后者的参数为34xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 加上其余的自我历史 改善这一点不到1%。 由于完全没有速度输入,BADS-3.0使用自己的速度估计. 校准对10个例子的估计可以恢复大部分损失的准确性。 BADAS-3.0的平均误差则低于每个基线,

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, and predicting what the driver would do is not the same as avoiding a collision. We therefore add two open-loop safety benchmarks that test whether the model’s trajectory avoids a collision in a high-risk event. The Euro NCAP benchmark replays the protocol’s collision-avoidance scenarios in simulation, and the Dashcam Collision Avoidance benchmark (DCA-Bench) uses real-world collisions and near-misses from dashcam footage. BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than any published planner we tested.
blocks.zh: 现有的基准大多是名义驱动,预测驱动器会做什么与避免碰撞不同. 因此,我们增加了两个开放式安全基准,以检验该模型的轨迹是否避免在高风险事件中发生碰撞。 欧洲NCAP基准在模拟中重现了协议的碰撞避免假想,而Dashcam碰撞避免基准(DCA-Bench)则使用真实世界的碰撞和破碎镜头的近似漏. BADAS-3.0的通过率高于我们测试过的任何公布的计程员.

blocks.en: Finally, we evaluate BADAS-3.0 on the planning benchmark NavSim [ 11 ] . With the base model frozen, we fit six calibration parameters and train a selector for this benchmark. BADAS-3.0 then scores 89.0 PDMS, and 91.1 after fine-tuning (Section 4.4 ).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们对规划基准NavSim进行BADS-3.0的评价[11]. 随着基座模型被冻结,我们安装了6个校准参数,并为这个基准训练一个选手. BADAS-3.0然后得分89.0 PDMS,微调后得分91.1(第4.4节).

blocks.en: We also evaluate the speed, ego-pose and collision-risk heads, each against other systems for that task. For speed and ego-pose we compare against visual odometry and 3D reconstruction systems, and BADAS-3.0 has the lowest mean error. The model takes no camera intrinsics. The evaluation uses a camera’s focal length only to frame the image to the training field of view (Section 4.2 ). On a camera outside the training range, BADAS-3.0’s speed and ego-pose are off by a roughly constant factor. One scale per camera, fitted from ten labelled examples, removes most of that error. On five collision anticipation benchmarks, the risk head is within 0.02 AP of its teacher, the state-of-the-art BADAS-2.0 [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们还评估速度、自负率和碰撞风险头,相互对抗,以完成这项任务。 对于速度和自负率,我们比较了视觉光度测量和3D重建系统,而BADS-3.0的平均值最低. 模型没有摄像头内在。 评估使用相机的焦距只是为了将图像设定为培训视野(第4.2节)。 在训练范围以外的摄像头上,BADS-3.0的速度和自负率被一个几乎恒定的因素所抵消。 从10个标注的例子中安装的每台相机一个比例尺可以消除大部分错误。 在五个碰撞预测基准上,风险头位于其老师的0.02 AP,即最先进的BADAS-2.0 [22].

blocks.en: We make three contributions. First, a 1B single-camera model with the best mean accuracy on trajectory (with a speed sensor), ego-pose, speed and collision-risk benchmarks, at up to 100 × \times lower latency than frontier VLAs. Second, metric ego-pose and speed from one camera with no intrinsics given to the model, and a ten-example scale correction for cameras outside its training range. Third, two open safety benchmarks on which existing planners fail most scenarios.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,1B型单摄像头模型在轨迹(带有速度传感器),自负率,速度和碰撞风险基准上具有最佳平均精度的1B型单摄像头模型,其延迟度最高可达100xxxx秒,低于前沿VLA. 第二,从一个没有给模型带来内在内容的相机上 获得自负和速度, 以及一个十倍规模的校正 相机在其训练范围之外。 第三,两个公开的安全基准,现有规划人员无法通过这些基准。

blocks.en: We will release BADAS-3.0 open-source, along with the five benchmark files, the evaluation harness and our open-loop safety benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 我们将发布BADAS-3.0开源,同时发布五个基准文件,评价手段和我们的开源安全基准.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Self-supervised video representations. Generative world models such as GAIA-1 and GAIA-2 [ 23 , 55 ] and the Cosmos family [ 45 , 46 , 50 ] synthesise driving video from actions and scene attributes. BADAS-3.0 instead builds on V-JEPA [ 4 ] , which learns by predicting masked regions in latent space and showed that frozen probes on its representations rival task-specific systems; V-JEPA 2 [ 1 ] and V-JEPA 2.1 [ 41 ] scale this to 1B and 2B parameters respectively. Other large video encoders include VideoMAE V2 [ 63 ] , which reconstructs pixels at a similar scale, and Cosmos-Embed1 [ 51 ] , an industrial video embedder. Drive-JEPA [ 64 ] also pretrains a V-JEPA encoder on driving video, for a NavSim planner on one front camera; BADAS-3.0 adds metric speed, ego-pose and collision-risk heads and is evaluated across camera rigs. We find that the V-JEPA objective trained in-domain on dashcam video outperforms general video data (Section A.13 , supplement), and use such a model to initialise the backbone of BADAS-3.0.
blocks.zh: 自我监督的视频展示. GAIA-1和GAIA-2[23,55],宇宙家族[45,46,50]等基因世界模型从动作和场景属性合成驱动视频. BADAS-3.0取而代之的是V-JEPA[4],它通过预测潜伏空间中的蒙蔽区域来学习,并表明其代表物上的冷冻探测器与任务特定系统相竞争;V-JEPA 2 [1]和V-JEPA 2.1[41]分别将这个参数缩放到1B参数和2B参数。 其他大型视频编码器包括VideoMAE V2 [63],它以类似的尺度重建像素,以及Cosmos-Embed1 [51],工业视频嵌入器. Drive-JEPA [64] 还预留了一台V-JEPA在驱动视频上的编码器,用于一台前置摄像机上的NavSim规划器;BADAS-3.0增加了公制速度,自负率和碰撞风险头,并经过照相机平台的评价. 我们发现,V-JEPA的目标在瞬间摄像机视频方面接受过培训,超过了一般视频数据(A.13节,补充部分),并使用这种模式将BADS-3.0的骨干信息公布。

blocks.en: Vision-language-action policies such as Alpamayo-R1 [ 44 ] pair a Cosmos-Reason VLM with a diffusion-based action expert over the future horizon, with chain-of-causation reasoning trained by supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Its successors scale the same recipe, to 10.5B parameters for Alpamayo 1.5 and 34B for Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras [ 48 ] . Qwen-Drive [ 73 ] adds a planning expert to a 4B multimodal VLM that also handles 3D perception and scene question answering, and SimWAM [ 72 ] co-trains a pretrained video expert with a lightweight action expert and discards the video branch at inference. These planners take seconds per decision (Table 18 , supplement). Fixed anchors with learned offsets go back to MultiPath [ 6 ] , which predicts a distribution over a fixed set of anchor trajectories and regresses offsets for each. We use the same idea in control space, with anchors that are sequences of acceleration and curvature.
blocks.zh: 愿景-行动政策,如阿尔帕马约-R1[44] 将宇宙-Reason VLM与未来视野的传播行动专家配对,通过有监督的微调和强化学习对因果链推理进行培训. 它的继任者将同样的食谱比例为:阿尔帕马约1.5的10.5B参数和阿尔帕马约2 Super的34B参数,后者读取了6个相机[48]. Quen-Drive [73] 在同时处理3D感知和场景问题解答的4B型多式联运VLM中增加了一名规划专家,SimWAM [72]与一名训练有素的视频专家与一名轻量级动作专家联手,推论时丢弃视频分支. 这些规划者每个决定需要几秒钟的时间(补充表18)。 具有有学识的抵消的固定锚返回到MultiPath [6],它预示着固定锚轨迹的分布,每个锚轨的退位抵消. 我们在控制空间中使用了同样的想法,锚是加速度和曲率的序列.

blocks.en: Monocular ego-motion. From one camera, metric scale is unobservable without extra sensing or priors, and methods differ in how they recover it. XVO [ 27 ] regresses metric motion from pixels; ZeroVO [ 28 ] , OpenVO [ 43 ] and UniDepth-V2 with PnP [ 53 ] estimate intrinsics or depth explicitly; VGGT [ 62 ] , DGGT [ 9 ] , MASt3R-SLAM [ 42 ] and DPVO [ 58 ] recover paths up to scale [ 65 , 29 ] . Our head is metric with no intrinsics, no alignment, causal and stateless.
blocks.zh: 独觉自性动. 从一个相机中,没有超感知或前兆的度量尺度是无法观测的,在如何回收时方法不同. XVO [27] 从像素上递减了度量运动; ZeroVO [28], OpenVO [43] 和 Uni Depth-V2 与 PnP [53] 明确估计内在或深度; VGGT [62], DGGT [9], MAT3R-SLAM [42] 和 DPVO [58] 恢复路径,其规模达到 [65,29]. 我们的头是衡量的,没有内在因素,没有一致性,没有因果关系和无国籍状态。

blocks.en: Collision anticipation. Anticipating a crash from one forward camera was posed as frame-level prediction on DAD [ 7 ] and later benchmarks [ 2 , 17 , 69 , 40 ] . Early models attend over detected objects [ 26 , 2 , 3 ] ; later ones add context or robustness [ 34 , 36 , 37 ] , language and attention supervision [ 18 , 19 , 35 ] , or new labels [ 71 , 75 ] , and video foundation encoders now lead the benchmarks [ 60 , 30 , 52 , 54 ] . The BADAS series, BADAS-1.0 [ 21 ] and BADAS-2.0 [ 22 ] , achieved state-of-the-art performance by fine-tuning V-JEPA 2 [ 1 ] for collision anticipation but these models were specialised to only this task. BADAS-3.0 uses BADAS-2.0 as the risk head’s teacher but expands beyond just collision anticipation.
blocks.zh: 碰撞预期。 设想从一台前置相机坠毁,被作为DAD[7]和后来基准[2,17,69,40]的帧级预测. 早期的模型在检测到的物体上参与[26,2,3];后期的模型添加上下文或强性[34,36,37],语言和注意力监督[18,19,35],或新标签[71,75],视频基础编码器现在主导基准[60,30,52,54]. BADAS系列,BADS-1.0 [21]和BADS-2.0 [22],通过微调V-JEPA 2 [1]的碰撞预测,实现了最先进的性能,但这些模型只用于这项任务。 BADS-3.0使用BADS-2.0作为风险头的老师,但扩展范围超出了碰撞预期。

blocks.en: Safety benchmarks. Trajectory benchmarks such as nuScenes [ 5 ] , Argoverse 2 [ 66 ] and Waymo [ 57 ] score a planner against the path the driver took, and those recordings are almost entirely safe, routine driving. NavSim [ 11 ] adds no-collision and time-to-collision terms to its score on recorded drives. AlpaSim [ 44 ] replays 75 recorded drives chosen for dense interactions and counts the close encounters a planner causes. WOD-E2E [ 68 ] rates plans on long-tail scenes against human preference. In each, the recorded outcome is safe and the planner fails by leaving it. NeuroNCAP [ 38 ] , Bench2Drive [ 25 ] and SafeBench [ 67 ] do place hazards on a collision course, in closed loop, on synthetic or reconstructed scenes. What is missing is a test that starts from a collision already under way, on a real road as well as on a protocol, and that any released planner can take open-loop, from the same frames, without being wired into a simulator.
blocks.zh: 安全基准。 轨迹基准如nuScenes [5],Argoverse 2 [66] 和Waymo [57] 对照驾驶员走的路给计划员打分,这些录音几乎完全安全,例行驾驶. NavSim [11] 在录制驱动器上的分数中增加了无曲线和时间对曲线术语. AlpaSim [44] 重播75个为密集交互选择的录制驱动器,并算出近距离相遇是一个规划者的原因. WOD-E2E [68] 对长尾场景的评分计划与人类偏好相对. 在每一个中,记录的结果都是安全的,计划者因离开而失败. NeuronNCAP [38], Bench2Drive [25] 和Safe Bench [67] 将危险放在碰撞过程中,以闭环方式,放在合成或重建的场景上. 所缺少的是一个测试,它从已经发生的碰撞开始,在一条真正的道路上和在协议上,任何被释放的策划者都可以从同一个框架走开,而无需被线接入模拟器.

blocks.en: 3 The Model
blocks.zh: 3 模式

blocks.en: BADAS-3.0 consists of a 1B-parameter ViT backbone with four separate heads. Each head is an attentive pooler followed by a small network.
blocks.zh: BADS-3.0由一个1B参数的VIT骨干组成,四个独立的头. 每一个头都是一个细心的池子,然后是小网络。

blocks.en: Backbone. The backbone takes as input a single 2 s video clip at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution and 8 fps. It is initialised from a model pretrained from scratch with the V-JEPA objective [ 4 ] over around 110,000 hours of proprietary dashcam video. All four heads are lightweight readouts of the same backbone features. The backbone uses a patch size of 16 × 16 × 2 16\times 16\times 2 ( H × W × T H\times W\times T ), so the input clip becomes 2048 tokens of 1408 dimensions each. Forty transformer layers turn these tokens into the output patch features.
blocks.zh: 后b骨. 骨干以256×256256\times 256分辨率和8 fps作为输入的单2 s视频剪辑. 它从一个预先从零开始训练的模型中被宣布为V-JEPA目标[4],超过11万小时的专有短镜头视频。 所有四个头都是轻量级读取相同的骨干特性. 骨干采用16×16×2的补丁尺寸,16\times 16\times 2(H×W×T H×Times W\times T),因此输入片段变为2048个符号,每个符号尺寸为1408维. 四十个变压器层将这些符号转化为输出补丁特性.

blocks.en: We use Δ ​ t = 0.1 \Delta t=0.1 s and roll out trajectories for 64 steps giving future trajectories up to 6.4s ahead. The max \max in the speed update floors the speed at zero, so a candidate that brakes to a stop stays stopped instead of rolling backward. Training and the safety selector use the update without this floor, so the floor changes only the geometry of candidates that stop. Table 15 (supplement) measures its effect. The one boundary condition is v 0 v_{0} , which comes either from an external speed sensor or from BADAS-3.0’s speed head. Section 4.1 defines the sensor, the zero-shot speed head and a speed head calibrated from ten examples, and Section 4.2 compares them and benchmarks the speed head itself.

blocks.en: BADAS-3.0 produces K = 6 K=6 candidate trajectories from each input rather than just one. To do this it uses a set of mode anchors, 𝐀 k ∈ ℝ 64 × 2 \mathbf{A}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{64\times 2} , which are fixed sequences of acceleration and curvature controls. These are precomputed via k k -means over the training set (Figure 8 , supplement). The logits 𝐬 \mathbf{s} are trained only to identify k ⋆ k^{\star} , the candidate closest to the driven path, and nothing in that rewards safety: a driver who crashed is matched as closely as one who braked. blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: BADAS-3.0 is trained in stages, because each head needs different data.
blocks.zh: BADAS-3.0分阶段训练,因为每个头都需要不同的数据.

blocks.en: Initial training of backbone and trajectory head. We take the V-JEPA pretrained backbone and initialise the trajectory head. We train both end-to-end on 𝒟 PAI \mathcal{D}_{\text{PAI}} with the closest-mode loss of Equation 2 against the ground truth future trajectory. The backbone is frozen for the first 2,000 steps to allow the trajectory head to warm up before being unfrozen for a further 140,000 steps. Ego history is always provided in full.
blocks.zh: 骨干和弹道头的初步训练。 我们把V -JEPA 预先训练的骨干 并公布轨道头。 我们在 DPAI \ mathcal{D}_{\text{PAI} 上进行两端对端的训练, 最近的模式损失 方程式 2 与地面真实的未来轨迹。 骨干为前2000步冷冻,让轨迹头部在解冻前加热,再加冻14万步. 爱果历史总是完整提供.

We update the head only for 500 steps and then the full model for another 8,500. We select the best checkpoint using validation ADE against a held-out set.

blocks.en: 3.5 Runtime

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Three sources of speed
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 三个速度来源

blocks.en: The unicycle model needs an initial speed, and we test three sources for it. In the sensor setting, the true speed comes from an external sensor or the ego history. In the zero-shot setting, the true speed is unavailable and BADAS-3.0 uses its own speed head. In the few-shot setting, we have ten examples from the target dataset or vehicle, annotated with the true speed. We fit one scale to the speed head on them, the ratio of the summed true speeds to the summed predicted speeds. We apply the scale only when it differs from one by more than twice its standard error and by more than 5%. Otherwise we keep the zero-shot prediction. The ten examples are not scored (Section A.19 , supplement).
blocks.zh: 单循环模型需要初始速度,我们为此测试三个来源. 在传感器设定中,真实速度来自外部传感器或自负历史. 在零射入的设定中,真实速度无法使用,BADS-3.0使用自己的速度头. 在几发设定中,我们从目标数据集或飞行器中得到了十个例子,以真实速度注释. 我们用一个尺度来计算它们的速度, 即总和真实速度与总和预测速度的比例。 我们只当比比额与标准误差1倍以上,且误差超过5%时,才适用比额. 否则我们就保持零射的预测 这10个例子没有得分(A.19节,补编)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Benchmarking the output heads
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 产出头的基准

blocks.en: Datasets. For trajectory forecasting we use five public driving sets: nuScenes [ 5 ] , Argoverse 2 Sensor and TbV [ 66 ] , Waymo [ 57 ] and PAI-644, a held-out split of 644 PhysicalAI-AV clips [ 47 ] . The ground truth is the driven path, 64 waypoints at 10 Hz from 0.1 to 6.4 s in the ego frame at t 0 t_{0} . Ego-pose uses the same five sets plus KITTI [ 20 ] , with two windows per PAI-644 clip. Speed uses the same sets as ego-pose but replaces PAI-644 with PAI-100c, 100 other PhysicalAI-AV clips. Collision risk uses five collision anticipation datasets under the conventions of [ 22 ] : Nexar Public [ 40 ] , the long-tail set of [ 22 ] , DAD [ 7 ] , DoTA [ 69 ] and DADA-2000 [ 17 ] . DAD, DoTA and DADA-2000 use the ego-centric labelling from [ 21 ] .
blocks.zh: 数据集. 在轨迹预测方面,我们使用5套公共驾驶装置:nuScenes [5]、Argoverse 2传感器和TbV [66]、Waymo [57]和PAI-644, 被搁置的644个物理AI-AV片段[47]。 地面真相是驱动的路径,64个方向点在10赫兹从0.1到6.4秒的自负框架在t 0 t_{0}. Ego-pose使用相同的五套加上KITTI [20],每PAI-644片段有两个窗口. 速度使用与自负pose相同的套装,但将PAI-644替换为PAI-100c,另外100个PhysicalAI-AV剪辑. 根据[22]项公约,碰撞风险使用五个碰撞预期数据集: Nexar Public [40],长尾集[22],DAD [7],DOTA [69]和DADA-2000 [17]. DAD,DOTA和DADA-2000使用[21]中以自我为中心的标签.

blocks.en: Baselines. For trajectories we compare against the Alpamayo family [ 48 , 44 , 49 ] . Qwen-Drive’s released head [ 73 ] stops at 5 s, so we compare with it at that horizon in the supplement (Table 13 ). Each model receives its native camera and ego-history inputs. BADAS-3.0 was trained on 16:9 cameras whose focal length is 0.48 to 0.60 of the frame width. The front cameras of nuScenes, Argoverse 2 and Waymo are narrower. Before the 256 × 256 256\times 256 resize, we place their frames on a 16:9 canvas on which the focal length is 0.60 of the canvas width, the value of the training dashcam. The focal lengths come from each dataset’s calibration, and cameras inside the training range are untouched (Section A.19 , supplement). For speed and ego-pose we compare against metric visual-odometry pipelines and scale-free 3D-reconstruction systems, all run at their native resolution. Each baseline’s speed is the magnitude of its last-step translation. For collision risk we compare against the earlier BADAS models [ 21 , 22 ] and several public VLMs.
blocks.zh: 基线。 对于轨迹,我们比较阿尔帕马约家族[48,44,49]. Quen-Drive的释放头[73]在5s时停止,因此我们在补编(表13)中将它与这一前景相比较。 每个模型都接收其原生相机和自我历史投入. BADS-3.0在16:9的相机上接受了训练,其焦距为帧宽的0.48至0.60. nuScenes,Argoverse 2和Waymo的前置摄像头较窄. 在256×256 256\times 256的调整尺寸之前,我们把他们的帧放在16:9的画布上,焦距是画布宽度的0.60,训练的破卡片值. 焦距来自每个数据集的校准,而训练范围内的摄像头则未受影响(A.19节,补编)。 对于速度和自我定位,我们比较一下 与公制的视觉-测量管 和无尺度的3D重建系统, 都以它们自己的分辨率运行。 每个基准的速度是其最后一步翻译的幅度。 关于碰撞风险,我们比较了早先的BADS模型[21,22]和几种公开的VLM.

blocks.en: Metrics. Trajectories are scored by minADE 6 [ 5 , 66 , 15 ] , the average displacement error in metres of the best of six candidates against the ground truth. Speed is measured by the mean absolute error (MAE) in m/s of the predicted speed at the end of the clip. For ego-pose we report the median absolute trajectory error (ATE), the RMS distance in metres over the twenty poses of the two-second path in the ego frame at t 0 t_{0} , with a median taken over all windows. The raw ATE is unaligned, so it includes scale error. We also report ATE after a per-window similarity fit of rotation, translation and scale, which leaves only the shape error on which scale-free methods are comparable. Collision risk is measured via mAP@TTA on the Nexar Public dataset [ 40 ] (the mean AP at 0.5, 1.0 and 1.5 s before the accident) and clip-level AP elsewhere.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 轨迹以分数6 [5,66,15] 得分,6位候选人中最优秀者的平均迁移误差以米计,与地面真理相对应. 速度由片段末端预测速度的m/s中的平均绝对误差(MAE)来测量. 对于自我,我们报告中位绝对轨迹误差(ATE), RMS 距离在自负框架的二秒路径的二十个姿势上以米为单位的距离为T0 t_{0},所有窗口都取下中位数。 原始的ATE是不对齐的,所以它包括了尺度误差. 我们还在旋转、翻译和比例的每个窗口相似度之后报告ATE,这只留下了无比例方法可比的形状错误。 碰撞风险通过Nexar公共数据集的mAP@TTA(事故前的平均值AP为0.5,1.0和1.5s)和剪辑级AP在其他地方进行测量.

blocks.en: Trajectory forecasting. With one camera, a speed sensor and the ego history, BADAS-3.0 has a mean minADE 6 of 0.95 m (Table 1 , Figure 2 ). That is 44% lower than Alpamayo 2 Super at 1.69 m, which has 34 × \times more parameters and reads six cameras. The lowest baseline mean is 1.60 m, from the 2B Alpamayo 2 Edge. BADAS-3.0 is also ahead of Qwen-Drive at its 5 s horizon, at 0.64 m against 1.89 m (Table 13 , supplement).
blocks.zh: 轨迹预测. 有了一台相机,一个速度传感器和自负历史,BADS-3.0的中位元ADE 6为0.95 m(表1,图2 ). 这比阿尔帕马约2 Super在1.69米低44%,它有34×xxxx%时多的参数并读取了6个摄像头. 最低基线平均值为1.60米,来自2B Alpamayo 2边缘。 BADS-3.0也领先于Quen-Drive 5 s 的地平线, 0.64 m对比 1.89米(补充表13)。

blocks.en: The gap comes from cameras the models were not trained on. Most of it is on nuScenes and the two Argoverse sets. On Waymo, BADAS-3.0 is 0.27 m ahead of the best baseline. On PAI-644, which both BADAS-3.0 and Alpamayo 2 Super were trained on, the two are essentially on par, at 0.93 m and 0.96 m.
blocks.zh: 缺口来自没有受过训练的摄像机。 大部分在nuScens和两套Argoverse上. 在Waymo上,BADS-3.0比最佳基线提前0.27米. 在BADAS-3.0和Alpamayo 2 Super都接受了培训的PAI-644上,两者基本处于平价水平,分别为0.93米和0.96米。

blocks.en: Without a speed sensor, BADAS-3.0 must use its own speed prediction, and the mean rises to 1.68 m (zero-shot). Calibrating the speed head on ten labelled examples recovers 58% of that rise (few-shot, 1.26 m). The few-shot mean is below every baseline’s mean.
blocks.zh: 没有速度传感器,BADS-3.0必须使用自己的速度预测,平均值上升至1.68米(零射). 在10个标注的例子上校正速度头可恢复58%的上升(射箭,1.26米)。 几发子弹的平均值低于每个基线的平均值。

blocks.en: minADE 6 credits the best of six candidates, but a car drives only one. BADAS-3.0’s top-ranked candidate has a mean ADE of 2.71 m (top-1 column, Table 1 ). Alpamayo 2 Super has 3.42 m, averaged over its six samples because it does not rank them. On PAI-644, Alpamayo’s single paths are closer to the driver’s. The safety selector’s choice has a mean ADE of 2.73 m, closer than any Alpamayo model’s single path (3.34 to 3.74 m).
blocks.zh: 分钟 6位候选人中成绩最佳,但一辆汽车只开一辆. BADAS-3.0排名最高的候选人的平均ADE为2.71米(最高一栏,表1)。 阿尔帕马约2 Super拥有3.42米,平均超过其6个样本,因为它没有将其排位. 在PAI-644上,阿尔帕马约的单行道更接近驾驶者. 安全选择者的选择平均ADE为2.73米,比任何阿尔帕马约模型的单径(3.34至3.74米)更接近.

On Waymo, a camera the head never saw, zero-shot is a straight line at 0.76 of the truth (through-origin fit; the benchmark-wide scale bias is 0.75) and k k lifts it to 0.97. On the training distribution k k is already near one and the two clouds coincide.

blocks.en: Speed estimation. BADAS-3.0’s speed head is more accurate than every odometry pipeline on five of six datasets and has the lowest mean MAE (Table 7 , supplement, and Figure 3 ). Calibrating on ten labelled examples cuts the mean error by 58%. The largest gains are on Waymo (59%) and KITTI (83%).
blocks.zh: 速度估计。 BADS-3.0的速度头比六个数据集中的五个数据集的每个odometry管道都更准确,平均MAE值最低(表7,补充和图3)。 对10个标注的例子进行校准将平均误差减少58%. Waymo(59%)和KITTI(83%)的收益最大。

blocks.en: Ego-pose prediction. BADAS-3.0 has the lowest mean error on both measures (Table 2 , and Table 6 and Figure 6 in the supplement). Zero-shot, its Mean 6 ATE is 1.18 m. The metric visual-odometry pipelines are at 1.89 to 3.04 m and take 190 ms to 9.4 s per window, against 43 ms. After a per-window similarity fit removes scale, BADAS-3.0’s Mean 6 error is 3.5 cm, and the next system, DPVO, is at 4.0 cm. So BADAS-3.0’s paths have the right shape, and most of the remaining error is length, which depends on the camera. Calibrating on ten labelled examples from the target camera cuts the error by 66%, to 0.40 m.
blocks.zh: Ego -pose预测。 BADAS-3.0在这两种措施中的平均误差最低(补编表2和表6和图6)。 0射门,它的6ATE平均值为1.18米. 公尺视-odometry输油管在1.89至3.04米处,每扇窗户需要190米至9.4秒,对43米。 每个窗口的相似度适合去除比例后,BADS-3.0的平均值6误差为3.5cm,下一个系统DPVO为4.0cm. 因此BADAS-3.0的路径有正确的形状,剩下的大部分错误是长度,这取决于相机. 校准目标摄像头的10个标注实例,将误差减少66%,降至0.40米.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Collision anticipation. mAP@TTA on Nexar Public, scored under two protocols (single-window, the competition’s, and sliding window), clip-level AP elsewhere. Baseline rows are the published predictions of the BADAS-2.0 comparison [ 22 ] . DAD has 13 ego-involved positives.
blocks.zh: 表3:预计碰撞情况。 mAP@TTA on Nexar Public, 根据两个协议(单窗、比赛和滑动窗口)得分, 基线行是公布的BADS-2.0比较预测[22]. DAD有13个自我参与的积极因素.

blocks.en: Collision anticipation. The risk head is distilled from BADAS-2.0 [ 22 ] , the previous state of the art. It is ahead of its teacher on Nexar Public under both protocols and on the long-tail set. It ties the teacher on DoTA and DADA-2000 and trails it by 0.006 AP on DAD (Table 3 ). Its attention falls on the hazard, as BADAS-2.0’s does (Figure 7 , supplement).
blocks.zh: 碰撞预期。 风险头由BADAS-2.0[22]蒸馏而成,这是之前的先进水平. 根据两项协议,它领先于Nexar Public和长尾系列的教师。 它将教师联系在DOTA和DADA-2000上,并在DAD上追踪到0.006AP(表3). 正如BADS-2.0的(图7,补编)那样,它的注意力落在危险上。

blocks.en: 4.3 Safety
blocks.zh: 4.3 安全问题

blocks.en: The trajectory benchmarks above score the model against the path the driver took, and in those cases the driver took a safe one. They therefore cannot say whether a planner avoids a collision that is already under way (Section 2 ).
blocks.zh: 以上轨迹基准比照驾驶员走的路对模型进行评分,在那些情况下,驾驶员采取安全路线。 因此,他们不能说计划者是否避免了已经发生的碰撞(第2节)。

blocks.en: We add two benchmarks built around imminent collisions, on which a planner passes by keeping clear of the hazard. The Euro NCAP benchmark replays the protocol’s collision-avoidance scenarios in CARLA [ 12 ] . The Dashcam Collision Avoidance benchmark (DCA-Bench) replays real dashcam collisions and near-misses. Each system provides one plan, which is checked against the hazard’s scripted or tracked path. No other agent reacts to it.
blocks.zh: 我们增加了两个围绕即将发生的碰撞制定的基准,一个规划者通过这些基准来避免危险。 Euro NCAP基准在CARLA [12] 中重现了协议的碰撞避免情景. Dashcam碰撞避免基准(DCA-Bench)重现了真实的破碎相机碰撞和近失. 每个系统都提供一种计划,对照危险脚本或跟踪路径检查。 没有其他代理对此作出反应.

blocks.en: Euro NCAP benchmark. The benchmark is made up of 356 scenario pairs over 15 protocol families, generated from OpenSCENARIO files [ 59 ] for the Euro NCAP Crash Avoidance Frontal Collisions protocol, v1.1 [ 16 ] . Each pair is made up of a scenario from the NCAP protocol and a hazard-free twin with the hazard entity removed. 256 pairs are on a straight road, with car, pedestrian, cyclist and motorcycle targets and 100 pairs are junction crossings. Each scenario is rendered using esmini [ 14 ] and CARLA according to the camera rig required by each system. For each scenario we define the last-chance instant as the last timestep where a brake at 6 m/s 2 avoids the collision. We evaluate each model at the last-chance instant as well as 0.25 s and 0.5 s before. On the collision variants each system is scored with the Euro NCAP Standard scheme, rescaled from 0 to 1, with the average taken over the three time instants. On the hazard-free twin we report the false positive rate. A false positive is defined as a mean deceleration above 3.5 m/s 2 over any 0.5 s period or a lateral movement of more than 2.5 m in either direction. A pair is passed if the collision is avoided and there is no false positive.
blocks.zh: 欧洲NCAP基准. 该基准由15个协议家庭的356对情景组合组成,这些组合来自OpenSCENARIO文件[59],用于Euro NCAP Crash Crashance Frontal Collisions协议,v1.1 [16]. 每对由NCAP协议中的一种设想和与去除危险实体的无危险双胞胎组成。 256对在一条正路上,有汽车,行人,骑自行车和摩托车的目标,100对是交叉路口. 每种情况都使用esmini[14]和CARLA,根据每个系统所需的照相机进行。 对于每一种情景,我们定义最后的跳动瞬间,作为刹车在6米/秒2时避免碰撞的最后一步. 我们在最后一刻评估每个模型 以及0.25秒和0.5秒之前 在碰撞变体上,每个系统都与欧洲NCAP标准方案进行打分,从0级调整到1级,平均取下三个时间瞬间. 关于无危险的双胞胎,我们报告假阳性率。 假阳性被定义为在任何0.5个期间平均减速超过3.5 m/s 2,或者在两个方向的横向移动超过2.5 m. 如果避免碰撞并且没有假阳性,则一对通过.

blocks.en: DCA-Bench. The Euro NCAP scenarios are schematic. DCA-Bench tests systems on 100 real-world incidents, collisions and near-misses, from the test split of the Nexar Dashcam Collision Prediction Challenge [ 40 ] . Each clip is annotated with the ego and other road users’ trajectories and then cut at the final point before the event when the driver could avoid the collision. Each system sees the two seconds before the cut and produces a trajectory plan. The plan is replayed for 4 s against the reconstructed road users, who do not react, and fails if the ego box comes within 0.3 m of any of them, departs more than 2.5 m sideways from the recorded path or needs more than 8.8 m/s 2 of braking from the car’s true speed. This stops a plan that assumes a lower speed than the car’s true speed from passing by braking harder than a car can. As on Euro NCAP, each incident is paired with a hazard-free twin, cut from the same clip to end before the hazard is visible, and scored with the same false-positive and pair rules. Eighty-nine clips allow such a cut inside the public challenge clip, and the false-positive and pass rates are over these pairs (supplement).
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-03-27). DCA-Bench. 欧洲国家气候方案设想方案是图表式的。 从Nexar Dashcam碰撞预测挑战的测试分裂中,DCA-Bench测试了100个真实世界事件,碰撞和近乎缺失的系统[40]. 每个片段都带有自负和其他道路使用者的轨迹,然后在事发前司机可以避免碰撞的最后阶段剪断。 每个系统都能看到切开前的两秒钟并产生一个轨迹计划. 计划针对重建后的公路使用者进行重播,他们没有反应,如果自负盒在其中0.3米以内,则失败,离开记录道路2.5米以上,或者需要超过8.8米/秒的刹车速度。 这阻止了一个假设速度低于汽车真实速度的计划, 与Euro NCAP一样,每个事件都配有无危险双胞胎,从同一个剪辑中切到危险可见前结束,并得分时采用相同的假阳性和对规则. 89个片段允许在公共挑战片段内部进行这样的剪切,假阳性和通过率都超过了这些对(补充).

blocks.en: Table 4 : Euro NCAP benchmark (356 scenario pairs) and DCA-Bench (100 real incidents). The Euro NCAP score is the fraction of the protocol’s points held, averaged over the three commit instants. FP rate and pass rate (% of the 356 pairs) are at the last-chance instant. Each planner uses its own camera rig, and BADAS-3.0 uses sensor speed and ego history. Rows are sorted by Euro NCAP pass rate, with the best planner per pass-rate column in bold. On DCA-Bench every planner reads the one dashcam, BADAS-3.0 with the camera alone, and rates are over the 89 incident–twin pairs. † Mean of 6 runs.
blocks.zh: 表4:欧洲NCAP基准(356个情景对)和DCA-Bench(100个实际事故)。 Euro NCAP 得分是协议积分的一小部分, FP率和通过率(356对的%)处于最后时刻. 每个规划师都使用自己的相机钻机,而BADS-3.0则使用传感器速度和自负历史. 行按Euro NCAP通过率排序,每个通过率列的最佳计划者用粗体表示. 在DCA-Bench上,每个计划员都只读到一台光滑相机,BADS-3.0,而速率超过了89个事件-双对。 平均6次比赛。

blocks.en: Results. On Euro NCAP (Table 4 ) we evaluate BADAS-3.0 with sensor speed and ego history in two camera configurations, a 75 ∘ view and a 150 ∘ view stitched from three cameras. The wider view can capture hazards coming from the side.
blocks.zh: 结果。 在Euro NCAP(表4)上, 更广泛的观点可以捕捉来自侧面的危险。

blocks.en: BADAS-3.0 leads every planner we tested with either configuration, although it was never trained on simulated data. With the 75 ∘ view its score is 0.296, against 0.202 for the next best planner. With the 150 ∘ view, which is outside its training data, its score is 0.365 and its pass rate rises from 15.4% to 19.1%. Qwen-Drive and SimWAM score at most 0.030.
blocks.zh: BADAS-3.0 带领我们测试过的所有计划员 使用两种配置,尽管它从未接受过模拟数据的培训。 以75 QQ的视线,它的得分是0.296,而下一位最佳策划者则是0.202. 凭借150QQ的视野,其训练数据之外,其分数为0.365分,通过率从15.4%上升到19.1%. Quen-Drive和SimWAM的得分最多为0.030分.

blocks.en: On DCA-Bench (last two columns), every planner reads the one dashcam of the public challenge clips. The other planners also get ego history, and BADAS-3.0 reads the camera alone. BADAS-3.0 passes 39% of the pairs, over twice any other planner (0 to 18%). The recorded driver passes 45%, because some incidents were near-misses. Seven of BADAS-3.0’s 12 false positives come from planning at a speed below the true one, since it has no speed input. A control that always brakes at 6 m/s 2 passes 98 of the 100 incidents but fails 93% of the twins.
blocks.zh: 在DCA-Bench(最后两个栏目)上,每个计划员都会阅读公开挑战片段的一个破片. 其他策划者也获得自负历史,BADS-3.0只读相机. BADAS-3.0通过39%的配对,超过其他任何规划者的两倍(0到18%). 记录的司机超过45%,因为有些事件几乎失事。 BADAS-3.0的12个假阳性中,有7个来自计划速度低于真阳性,因为它没有速度输入. 控制器总是在6 m/s 2时刹车,通过100起事件中的98起,但93%的双胞胎失败.

The backbone and every head are frozen when the safety selector is trained, so both rows have the same six candidates and differ only in which one is chosen. Ranked by the trajectory head alone, which is trained to imitate the driver, BADAS-3.0 passes 20% of the DCA-Bench pairs, just above the best other planner (18%). blocks.en: 4.4 NavSim
blocks.zh: 4.4 导航系统

blocks.en: We evaluate BADAS-3.0 on the planning benchmark NavSim v1 [ 11 ] , scored by the PDM score (PDMS). First we keep BADAS-3.0 frozen and fit six calibration parameters against ADE on 4,000 navtrain scenes. We then train a NavSim selector on navtrain, a regression model that predicts each candidate’s PDMS and picks the highest. It is separate from the safety selector and used for this benchmark alone. Second, we fine-tune BADAS-3.0 on navtrain with LoRA [ 24 ] , then apply GRPO to the full model and the NavSim selector. The comparison planners are all trained on navtrain, some of them with RL. We also report the best-of-6 PDMS, the score of the best candidate per scene.
blocks.zh: 我们评价BADAS-3.0在规划基准NavSim v1[11],得分为PDM分数(PDMS). 首先,我们保持BADS-3.0的冷冻,在4000个导航场景上与ADE匹配6个校准参数. 我们随后在导航列车上训练一个NaveSim选择器,这是一个回归模型,它预测每个候选人的PDMS并选择最高的. 它与安全选择器分开,仅用于这一基准。 第二,在与LORA[24]的导航上微调BADAS-3.0,然后将GPRO应用到全模型和NavSim选择器上. 比较规划师都接受过航海训练,其中一些与RL. 我们还报告最佳6PDMS,每个场景最佳候选人的得分.

blocks.en: Results. With the frozen model and six calibration parameters, BADAS-3.0 reaches 89.0 PDMS from one camera (Table 19 , supplement). Among the non-RL planners we compare against, only SimWAM SFT is higher, at 90.3. LoRA fine-tuning lifts BADAS-3.0 to 90.0 and GRPO to 91.1. SimWAM scores 91.9 after RL, and the other RL planners score 89.1 to 91.0. The best-of-6 PDMS of BADAS-3.0’s candidates is 96.3 after GRPO (Table 20 , supplement), so the selection limits the score more than the candidate set does.
blocks.zh: 结果。 通过冷冻模型和6个校准参数,BADS-3.0从一个相机中达到89.0PDMS(表19,补充). 相比之下,在非RL规划者中,只有SimWAM SFT较高,为90.3。 LoRA微调将BADS-3.0升至90.0,GPRO升至91.1。 SimWAM在RL之后得分91.9,其他RL规划者则得分89.1比91.0. BADS-3.0最佳6PDMS的考生在GRPO(表20,补充)之后为96.3人,因此选拔限制得分比考生集多.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion and limitations
blocks.zh: 5 结论和限制

blocks.en: From one forward camera, the 1B-parameter BADAS-3.0 returns speed, metric ego-pose, collision risk and six candidate futures in under 50 ms. On trajectory forecasting it is on par with Alpamayo 2 Super on the camera they share and ahead on the other four sets. Its speed and ego-pose heads have the lowest mean error among the systems we compare against. On two new safety benchmarks it has a higher pass rate than any other planner we tested.
blocks.zh: 1B参数BADS-3.0返回速度、自负率、碰撞风险和50米以下的6个候选期货。 在轨迹预测上,它与阿尔帕马约2 Super在他们共享的相机上和在其他四套相机上处于同等地位。 其速度和自负率是我们比较的系统中最小的差错。 在两个新的安全基准上,它的通过率比我们测试过的任何其他计划人员都高。

blocks.en: Limitations. The short, single-camera input that makes BADAS-3.0 fast also limits it. The model sees two seconds from a forward camera with no state between windows and is not trained in closed loop. So it cannot anticipate hazards beside it, behind it or out of view, and drift accumulates over long drives. Both safety benchmarks are open-loop, and other road users do not react to the plan. The backbone and the safety selector are trained on proprietary dashcam data, so their training cannot be reproduced, although we release the weights. DAD has only 13 ego-involved positives, so its AP is noisy.
blocks.zh: 限制。 使BADS-3.0快速的短片单镜头输入也限制了它. 模型从一个前置相机中看到两秒钟,窗口之间没有状态,也没有在闭环中训练. 因此,它无法预见其周围、其背后或视线外的危害,漂移会积聚在漫长的路程中。 这两种安全基准都是开放的,其他道路使用者对计划没有反应. 骨干和安全选择者接受过专有的破烂相机数据的培训,所以他们的训练无法复制,尽管我们释放了权重. DAD只有13个自负的阳性,所以它的AP很吵.

blocks.en: Task. Each method reads a 15-second front-camera segment and returns the ego path over the whole segment, expressed in the frame of its final pose. ATE is computed over the full path, and we report the median over segments with no alignment and after a similarity fit, as in Table 2 . The sets are PAI-644 (one segment per clip), 148 Argoverse 2 Sensor segments, 100 Waymo segments and 68 proprietary dashcam segments, the last with ground truth from 3D reconstruction. The baselines read the whole segment with their own sequence pipelines.
blocks.zh: 任务 每种方法都读取一个15秒前摄像头的片段,并返回整个片段的自我路径,用其最终姿势的框架来表示. ATE是按整个路径计算的,我们报告中位数高于没有对齐的区段,并如表2所示,经过相似度之后。 这套是PAI-644(每片段一个),148个Argoverse 2传感器片段,100个Waymo片段和68个专有短镜头片段,最后一个片段是3D重建的地面真相. 基线用它们自己的序列管道读取整个部分。

blocks.en: Chaining and stitching. BADAS-3.0 sees two seconds at a time and keeps no state, so a long path has to be assembled from windows. The simplest assembly, chained , slides the 16-frame window one frame at a time and joins consecutive windows by a rigid fit on their 1.875 s overlap. The stitcher replaces this with a small learned model. Windows are taken every 0.5 s, and for each one the stitcher reads the 128 pooled backbone tokens, the ego-pose head’s acceleration and curvature, the speed head’s v 0 v_{0} and the time since the previous window. A causal transformer over the last eight windows (three layers, width 256, 10.7M parameters) outputs a yaw-rate correction and a log standard deviation for each of the newest window’s 19 steps. The yaw rates of all overlapping windows are fused by inverse variance on a 0.1 s grid and integrated once with their mean speed, with the yaw rate set to zero below 0.5 m/s. The backbone and heads are frozen, so the two-second outputs are the same with or without the stitcher.
blocks.zh: 连锁缝合. BADAS-3.0一次看到两秒,没有状态,因此需要从窗口组装一条长的路径. 最简单的装配,链条式,一次滑动16帧窗口一个帧,通过紧凑的装在它们1.875的重叠上加入连续窗口. 缝合器用一个小的学习模型来代替这个. 视窗每0. 5 秒取下, 缝合器会读到128 个集合主干标志, 自负头的加速度和曲率, 速度头的 v 0 v_{0} 以及自上个窗口以来的时间 。 过去8个窗口(三层,宽度256,10.7M参数)上的一个因果变压器输出一个yaw率校正,以及每个最新窗口19个步骤的日志标准偏差. 所有重叠窗口的yaw率均由0.1s网格上的反差组成,并与其平均速度融合一次,yaw率设定为0低于0.5m/s. 骨干和头部都是冷冻的,所以两秒输出与缝合器是否相同.

blocks.en: Training. The stitcher is trained on 37.6k PhysicalAI-AV and 2.6k proprietary dashcam long clips with geometric camera-warp augmentation. The loss is a Huber loss on the wrapped cumulative yaw at 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and 8 s, weighted five times on turns, plus smaller position, uncertainty and climb-rate terms. It trains for six epochs on one A100.
blocks.zh: 培训。 缝合器采用37.6k PhysicalAI-AV和2.6k专有的破碎相机长片片段进行几何照相机-瓦式增容训练. 损失是包裹在0.5,1,2,4和8s的黄道上的胡伯损失,在转弯时加权5次,加上位置较小,不确定性和攀登率条件. 它在一个A100上为六个时代进行训练.

blocks.en: Results. Zero-shot, the stitcher lowers the error of chaining on every set in both columns of Table 8 , for example from 2.11 to 1.82 m on PAI-644 and from 2.82 to 2.44 m on AV2. On PAI-644, AV2 and the proprietary set zero-shot BADAS-3.0 has 3.7 to 7.6 × \times lower unaligned error than the best metric pipeline. On Waymo the zero-shot speed scale is off, as in Table 2 , and over 15 s the error grows to 10.1 m; ten calibration segments bring it to 4.7 m stitched and 4.2 m chained, the chained row below UniDepth-V2 + PnP at 4.4 m. On AV2 the zero-shot scale is already right: the gate keeps it for the stitched row (2.37 m on the scored segments) and the chained factor is 0.93 (2.73 m against 2.81 m zero-shot on the same segments). On the proprietary set the few-shot rows, fitted with the earlier rule, raise the error, from 4.9 to 10.7 m stitched. With sensor speed the stitched path is within 1.0 to 2.5 m, so most of the remaining error is speed. blocks.en: A.15 Head architectures
blocks.zh: A.15 联合国 主结构

blocks.en: All four heads read the 2048 patch tokens of 1408 dimensions produced by the backbone.
blocks.zh: 这四个头都读了骨干生产的1408维的2048个补丁符号.

blocks.en: Trajectory head. The given ego history is embedded into 20 tokens, which are combined with the patch tokens to form the memory tokens. If no ego history is provided, learned null tokens take their place. Six learned mode query tokens pass through three layers. In each layer the queries first attend to each other by self-attention, then to the memory tokens by cross-attention, and finally go through a feed-forward network. This gives one hidden state 𝐡 k ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{h}_{k}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} per mode. A single linear layer projects each 𝐡 k \mathbf{h}_{k} to a vector of dimension 128, which is reshaped to 64 × 2 64\times 2 to give the deltas Δ k \Delta_{k} .
blocks.zh: 轨迹头. 给定的自我历史嵌入了20个符符,这些符符符与补丁符符符结合形成记忆符符符. 如果不提供自负历史,学来的虚无象征就取代他们。 六个学习模式查询符通过三层. 在每层中,查询首先通过自我关注来互相关注,然后通过交叉关注来关注内存符号,最后通过一个向导网络. 这使得每个模式都有一个隐藏状态 h k {\ R d\ mathbf{ h}\\ k\\\ mathbb{ R} 。 一个单线性层将每个 h k\ mathbf{ h}_{k} 投射到128 维度的矢量上, 它被重塑为 64× 2 64\times 2, 以给出 deltas { k\ Delta_{k} 。

blocks.en: Ego-pose head. The patch features are mean-pooled over 4 × 4 4\times 4 spatial blocks, which leaves 128 tokens ( 4 × 4 × 8 4\times 4\times 8 ), and a linear layer projects each token from 1408 to 256 dimensions. A single query token attends to these tokens by cross-attention and is passed through an MLP, with a final projection to the four output parameters [ a 0 , a 1 , κ 0 , κ 1 ] [a_{0},a_{1},\kappa_{0},\kappa_{1}] .

blocks.en: Speed head. The speed head has the same architecture as the ego-pose head, with a final projection to a single scalar. The scalar is interpreted as log ⁡ ( v ^ + 0.1 ) \log(\hat{v}+0.1) and is trained with a Huber loss against log ⁡ ( v + 0.1 ) \log(v+0.1) .

blocks.en: Risk head. A single query token attends to all 2048 patch tokens by cross-attention, and an MLP maps the result to the output logit.

blocks.en: A.16 Training details
blocks.zh: A.16 培训细节

blocks.en: Trajectory loss: Huber ( β = 1 \beta{=}1 m) on the integrated x ​ y xy of the closest of six modes plus 0.5 cross-entropy on its index; the unicycle inside the loss advances the pose with the current state and then applies the current control. Risk: binary cross-entropy, weight 5, to the teacher’s probability ( λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 then 0.9 0.9 in the joint stage with the remainder on the hard collision label; λ = 1 \lambda=1 in the head-only continuation), over 1.88M windows. Speed: Huber on log ⁡ ( v 0 + 0.1 ) \log(v_{0}+0.1) . Ego-pose: Huber on the twenty past points. Stitcher: Huber on yaw and x ​ y xy of the fused track. The backbone is trained in the trajectory and joint stages and frozen afterwards, when the remaining heads are trained on cached tokens of 243,720 windows. Compute for the final weights: about 2,700 GPU-hours of pretraining and about 600 of adaptation (about 400 on eight A100s for the trajectory stage, 190 on eight H100s for the joint stage and 12 for the frozen-backbone stages). Parameters measured from the released checkpoint: 1,012.2M backbone and 17.8M heads.
blocks.zh: 轨迹损失:Huber(β = 1\beta{=}1 m)在6种模式中最接近的集成 x y xy 上加上其指数上的0.5横贯;损失内部的单循环随当前状态推进姿势,然后应用当前控制. 风险:二进制横冲直撞,重量5,对老师的概率(QQ=0.5\lambda=0.5,然后与硬碰撞标签上的剩余部分在关节阶段为0.90.9;QQ=1\lambda=1,仅限头部延续),超过1.88M窗口. 速度:在log QQ(v 0 + 0.1 )\log(v_{0}+0}+0.1)上的Huber. Ego-pose:Huber上二十个过去点. (原始内容存档于2018-10-25). Stitcher: Huber on yaw and xy xy of the fired track. 骨干在轨迹和关节阶段接受训练,然后冷冻,其余的头部则在243 720个窗口的缓存信号上接受训练。 计算最终重量:预训约2700GPU-hours和约600改造(轨迹级8A100约400,关节级190H100,冷冻后骨级12). 从释放的检查站测得的参数:1,012.2M骨干和17.8M头.

blocks.en: A.17 Joint risk training
blocks.zh: A.17 联合风险培训

blocks.en: In the joint stage of Section 3.4 the risk head is trained from initialisation while the trajectory head is already partly trained, and the backbone receives gradients from both objectives on different batches. During this stage the validation minADE 6 improves from 1.225 m to 1.209 m; a run from the same initialisation for the same number of steps without the risk objective reaches 1.208 m, so joint training does not hinder trajectory performance.
blocks.zh: 在第3.4节的联合阶段,风险头从初始化开始培训,而轨迹头已经接受部分培训,骨干从不同批次的两个目标上获得梯度。 在这一阶段,验证小行星6从1.225米提高到1.209米;没有风险目标的相同步骤从相同的初始化运行到1.208米,因此联合培训不妨碍轨迹运行。

blocks.en: A.18 NavSim details
blocks.zh: A.18 导航系统的细节

blocks.en: Table 19 : NavSim v1 navtest, PDM score of one committed trajectory , 12,146 scenes. Published rows are copied from their papers and were not re-run. The BADAS-3.0 rows commit the candidate a four-seed selector ensemble picks from the six (three seeds for the GRPO row): with the trajectory head’s controls recalibrated, after a LoRA fine-tune of backbone and head on navtrain, and after end-to-end GRPO through the LoRA backbone, head and a co-trained selector against the PDM score. The supplement gives the NavSim protocol in detail.

Published rows sample N N trajectories and are copied from their papers. BADAS-3.0 rows are the best of its six anchored candidates, from the released checkpoint, after recalibrating the controls, after the LoRA fine-tune and after end-to-end GRPO.
blocks.zh: 表20: NavSim v1 导航测试,最佳N型PDMS. 每个场景的最佳候选人,根据得分选择,所以这些都是一个候选人组合的上限,而不是规划者的结果. 已公布的行样N N轨迹并从其论文中复制. BADAS-3.0行是其六位锚定候选人中最优秀的,分别来自已放行的检查站,重新调整控制后,LORA微调后和端对端GRPO后.

blocks.en: Training stages. The recalibration and the LoRA fine-tune each start from the standard BADAS-3.0, and the GRPO stage continues from the LoRA model. The NavSim runs predate the floor at zero in Equation 1 : their candidates are rolled out without it, and only the trajectories of candidates that come to a stop would differ. Under best-of- 6 6 evaluation, BADAS-3.0 scores 86.4 86.4 on navtest.
blocks.zh: 培训阶段。 重新校准和LORA微调从标准的BADS-3.0开始,GRPO阶段从LORA模式继续. NavSim在方程式1中以0比0领先:他们的考生在没有该方程式的情况下被推出,只有来停站的候选人的轨迹不同. 在最佳6-6评价下,BADS-3.0在航海测试中得分86.486.4.

blocks.en: Recalibration. The backbone and all heads stay frozen. Six calibration parameters are applied to the trajectory head’s controls and fitted against 4,000 scenes from navtrain using the human trajectory as ground truth. The six parameters are made up of a scale, shift and ramp coefficient applied to each of the acceleration and curvature channels: x ↦ a ​ x + b + c ​ t x\mapsto ax+b+ct where t t ranges from 0 0 to 1 1 over the trajectory. This raises the best-of- 6 6 performance to 95.7 95.7 .
blocks.zh: 复次修习. 脊椎和头部都僵了 6个校准参数适用于轨迹头部的控制,并适用于4 000场景,这些场景来自航海中,以人类轨迹作为地面真理。 6个参数由适用于每个加速度和曲率通道的尺度、移向和坡度系数组成: x + b + c t x\mapsto ax+b+ct,其中 t t在轨迹上从0到11. 这提高了6-6的最好成绩,达到95.7 95.7。

blocks.en: LoRA fine-tune. We add rank-4 LoRA adapters to the attention and MLP layers of all 40 backbone layers and train them together with the trajectory head, 7.8M trainable parameters in all. The objective is the imitation objective of the original trajectory training (Section 3.4 ), run for two passes over the full navtrain training scenes. This achieves 95.5 95.5 under best-of- 6 6 .
blocks.zh: 罗拉微调. 我们在所有40个主干层的注意层和MLP层中增加了4级LORA适配器,并连同轨迹头,7.8M可训练参数一起进行训练. 目的是模仿最初的轨迹训练(第3.4节),在全部航海训练场景上跑两段。 这在最佳成绩6 6下达到了95.5 95.5。

blocks.en: Selector. To obtain a single predicted trajectory from the model’s candidates we fit a selector module. This predicts the PDM score of each candidate from which we take the argmax as our selection. The selector is a single self-attention block over the six candidate trajectories and trained with a squared-error loss against the true PDM scores. We fit a selector over four random seeds (three for the GRPO model) and ensemble them to form our final module. Using this selector architecture the recalibrated model achieves 89.0 on navtest and the LoRA model 90.0.
blocks.zh: 选者. 为了从模型的候选者那里获得一个单一的预测轨迹,我们配有一个选择模块。 这预示着每个候选人的PDM分数,我们从中选择方程式。 选手是6个候选赛道上的一个单一的自我关注区块,并且根据真实的PDM分数进行平方-误差的训练. 我们搭配了四个随机种子的选手(GRPO模型的3个选手),并把它们组合成我们的最后一个模块. 使用这种选择器架构,重新校准的模型在导航测试上实现了89.0,LORA模型达到了90.0.

blocks.en: GRPO. Starting from the LoRA model we continue with direct GRPO to jointly optimise the model and the selector. The reward is the PDM score of a sampled trajectory, and the LoRA adapters, the trajectory head and the selector are trained together. An imitation term and a KL penalty keep the model close to where it started. We train for 16 passes over the 16,000 navtrain scenes whose candidates include a gate-failing mode. This model achieves 96.3 under best-of- 6 6 and 91.1 with the selector on navtest.
blocks.zh: (原始内容存档于2018-09-13). GRPO. 从LORA模型开始,我们继续直接使用GRPO来共同优化模型和选择器. 奖励是采样轨迹的PDM得分,LORA适配器,轨迹头和选手一起训练. 仿制名词和KL罚则使模型接近其起始位置. 我们为16人训练 通过16000个导航场景, 其候选者包括一个故障门模式。 该型号在最优的6 6和91.1下实现96.3,选择者进行导航测试.

blocks.en: We also tested a braking offset, one scalar added to the recalibrated acceleration bias and swept against the true PDM scorer on 640 navtrain scenes. With it the selected score is 88.97, without it 88.98 (paired difference without minus with + 0.004 +0.004 , log-cluster interval [ − 0.47 , + 0.44 ] [-0.47,+0.44] ), so we report the version without it, in which the scorer never touches the model. A candidate set’s ceiling does not predict the selected score either. The recalibrated controls without the offset have the highest oracle (95.7) and tie the version with it on the selected score. The recalibration needs few scenes when measured in held-out displacement error, where eight scenes recover about 90% of the improvement, but displacement error and PDM score do not track each other on this model, so we do not claim the same for PDM score.
blocks.zh: 我们还测试了制动偏移,在重新调整的加速偏移上加了一个scalar,并在640个导航列车场景上扫射了真正的PDM计分器. 有了它,所选的分数是88.97,没有它的是88.98(分数差不减为+0.04+0.004,对数分组间隔[−0.47,+0.44]]),所以我们不报告这个版本,其中计分员从不接触模型. 候选人的上限也无法预测选定的得分。 无偏差的重排控制具有最高的甲骨文(95.7),并在选定的分数上将版本与它绑定. 重新校正在被搁置的移位错误中测量时需要的场景很少,其中八个场景恢复了约90%的改进,但移位错误和PDM分数在这个模型上并不互相跟踪,所以我们并不主张PDM分数相同.

blocks.en: A.19 Preparing a camera: input framing and calibration
blocks.zh: A.19 联合国 准备相机:输入框架和校准

blocks.en: A camera is prepared in two steps. Both are fixed once per camera and then reused for all of its video, and neither changes the weights. The first, framing, uses only the camera’s known parameters and needs no labels; the zero-shot rows use it alone. The second, calibration, fits one scale per output from ten labelled windows, and is what the few-shot rows add.
blocks.zh: 摄像头分两步准备. 两者每台相机固定一次,然后重新用于其所有视频,两者都不改变重量. 第一个是设定,只使用相机已知的参数,不需要标签;零射线单独使用. 第二,校准,符合10个标有标签的窗口的每个输出一个比例尺,是数发行所加的.

blocks.en: Framing. BADAS-3.0 was trained on 16:9 cameras whose focal length is 0.48 (PhysicalAI-AV front wide) to 0.60 (the dashcam) of the frame width. The front cameras of nuScenes (0.79), Argoverse 2 (1.09 to 1.15) and Waymo (1.08) are narrower. For these sets each native frame is placed, before the 256 × 256 256\times 256 resize, on a 16:9 canvas whose width is the focal length divided by 0.60, with black bars where the canvas is larger than the frame and a centre crop where the frame is taller. The target, 0.60, is the training dashcam’s measured value and the focal lengths come from each dataset’s calibration; no parameter is fitted to benchmark results. KITTI, PAI-644, PAI-100c and the dashcam sets are inside the training range and are resized as they are. Windows, ground truth, weights and every other method’s inputs are the same with and without the framing. Against resizing the full frame, the framing lowers BADAS-3.0’s error on these sets in every cell of Tables 1 and 2 and in every zero-shot cell of Table 7 . Three results get worse: the few-shot speed error on Argoverse 2 Sensor, compared under the earlier calibration rule (0.46 to 0.47 m/s; 0.46 m/s with Equation 6 ); the shape error after the similarity fit on Argoverse 2 Sensor (2.5 to 3.1 cm zero-shot) and Waymo (3.8 to 4.0 cm, Table 6 ); and the two-second error when the speed is given by the sensor, a reference that is not in Table 2 (0.14 to 0.21 m on Argoverse 2 Sensor and 0.15 to 0.19 m on TbV). The AV2 and Waymo segments of the full drives (Table 8 ) are framed the same way, frame by frame at their native resolution. There the framing lowers every zero-shot and sensor-speed cell without alignment and every cell after the similarity fit, and, compared under the earlier calibration rule, raised the few-shot error on AV2 (3.09 to 5.38 m stitched, 2.32 to 3.78 m chained); with Equation 6 these two cells are 2.37 and 2.73 m.
blocks.zh: 佛报. BADAS-3.0在16:9的相机上接受了训练,其焦距为0.48(PhysicalAI-AV前宽)至帧宽0.60(破碎相机). nuScenes(0.79),Argoverse 2 (1.09–1.15)和Waymo (1.08)的前置摄像头较窄. 对于这些套装,在256×256 256\times 256的调整尺寸之前,将每个原生框架放置在16:9的画布上,其宽度为焦距除以0.60,其中画布大于框架的黑色条条,框架高的中央作物. 目标0.60是训练短镜头的测量值,焦距来自每个数据集的校准;没有为基准结果设置参数。 KITTI,PAI-644,PAI-100c和破碎相机在训练范围之内,并按原样调整尺寸. Windows、地面真相、权重和所有其他方法的投入都是一样的,无论是否设定。 相对于重新调整全帧的大小,框架降低了表1和表2的每个单元格以及表7的每个零镜头单元格中BADS-3.0的这些数据集的错误。 三种结果变得更加糟糕:Argoverse 2 Sensor上的几发射速误差,比照早期的校准规则(0.46至0.47米/秒;0.46米/秒配方程式6);Argoverse 2 Sensor(2.5至3.1厘米零射)和Waymo(3.8至4.0厘米,表6)上的相似度之后的形状误差;以及传感器给出速度时的两秒误差,该误差不在表2(Argoverse 2 Sensor上的0.14至0.21米,TbV上的0.15至0.19米)中. 完整驱动器的AV2和Waymo部分(表8)按原声分辨率按框排列。 框架将每个没有对齐的零射和感光速电池降低,在类似性适合后每个电池降低,在早期的校准规则下,将AV2上的几发误差(3.09至5.38米缝合,2.32至3.78米连锁);方程式6的这两个电池是2.37和2.73米.

blocks.en: Earlier versions of these tables used an earlier rule, the shrunk geometric mean of the ten per-window ratios, applied on every set. Against it, the few-shot row of Table 1 moves from 1.19 to 1.22 m on nuScenes, where it gets worse, from 1.31 to 1.23 m on Argoverse 2 Sensor and from 1.08 to 1.06 m on TbV, and by less than 0.01 m on Waymo and PAI-644; its mean falls from 1.27 to 1.26 m and its top-1 mean rises from 3.28 to 3.30 m. The proprietary cells of Table 8 also keep it ( ‡ ); they were not re-run.
blocks.zh: 这些表格的早期版本采用了较早的规则,即每套十种窗内比例的缩窄几何平均值。 与此相反,表1的几弹一行在nuScenes上从1.19米移动到1.22米,情况恶化,在Argoverse 2 Sensor上从1.31米移动到1.23米,在TbV上从1.08米移动到1.06米,在Waymo和PAI-644上从0.01米移动到0.26米;其平均值从1.27米下降到1.26米,其最高-1平均值从3.28米上升到3.30米。 表7的几发射速误差在nuScenes,TbV,KITTI(比0.002 m/s)和PAI-100c(0.45至0.52 m/s)上变得更加严重,其平均值从0.51升至0.52 m/s;表2的几发射自负平均值从0.396升至0.400 m. 在表8中,AV2细胞从缝合的5.38米跌至2.37米,从链条的3.78米跌至2.73米,Waymo细胞从4.16米升至4.70米,从4.03升至4.15米。 表2和表8的PAI-644几发细胞保持了先前的规则(QQ),因为它们是从一个已经无法重建的切片的集合中得来的. 表8的专有单元格也保留它(QQ);它们没有重新运行。

blocks.en: Held-out check. The rule (the ratio of sums, the gate at two standard errors, the pseudo-observation, and distance pairs for the ego-pose rows) was selected using the benchmark sets themselves, which is model selection on the reported sets. It was then frozen and checked once on four ego-pose cells that took no part in the selection: the two-second windows of KITTI, and the two-second windows and 15-second segments of PAI-100c. The criteria were written down beforehand: not worse than zero-shot by more than 2%, and at least as good as the earlier rule on most cells. Table 21 gives the result.
blocks.zh: 暂停检查。 规则(总和的比例、两个标准差错的门、伪观察和自负线的距离对)是使用基准设定本身来选择的,这是在报告设定上的模型选择。 随后,它被冻结并检查了4个没有参与选择的自负细胞:KITTI的2秒窗口,以及PAI-100c的2秒窗口和15秒部分. 这些标准是事先写下来的:不比零射数高出2%以上,至少比以前大多数细胞的规则好。 表21给出了结果。

blocks.en: Table 21 : Held-out check of the calibration rule. Median ATE in metres with no alignment, every column on the same scored windows. Frozen rule: Equation 6 with the gate at two standard errors only. Result: the frozen rule against zero-shot. The last column adds the 5% minimum; it was introduced after the check and is not an independent result.
blocks.zh: 表21:对校准规则的停放检查。 中间 ATE 以米为单位,没有对齐,每个列在同一得分的窗口上. 冰冻规则:方程式6与门仅两个标准误差. 结果:对零射的冻结规则. 最后一栏增加了5%的最小值;它是在检查后引入的,不是独立的结果.

blocks.en: The check is mixed. Two of the four cells pass, and the frozen rule is not better than the earlier rule on most cells. The earlier rule is also worse than zero-shot on all three PAI-100c cells. On that camera the offset is real but small, about 3.5%, and ten windows cannot resolve it ( k ^ \hat{k} between 1.00 and 1.07 over random draws). The 5% minimum in Equation 6 was added after this check and because of it, so the last column of Table 21 is not an independent result. It closes the gate on one cell, the stitched 15-second cell; on the chained one k ^ = 1.052 \hat{k}=1.052 is just above the minimum. The check ran in fp32. The published KITTI and PAI-100c few-shot cells are bf16 runs, the precision of their zero-shot rows, so they differ from these by a few percent (KITTI, 2 s: 0.532 m). What the evidence supports is narrower than a general claim for the rule: ten labelled windows correct a gross scale error (KITTI, Waymo and Argoverse 2, 43 to 83% lower speed and ego-pose error under either rule), and for a camera inside the training range the zero-shot row is the one to use.
blocks.zh: 支票是混合的。 4个细胞中有2个通过,冷冻规则并不比以前大多数细胞的规则更好. 早期的规则也比所有三个PAI-100c细胞的零射入更糟糕. 相机上的偏移是真实的,但很小,大约为3.5%,10个窗口无法解决它(k^\hat{k}在1.00到1.07之间随机抽取)。 方程式6中的最低5%是在此检查之后加上的,并因此加入,因此表21的最后一栏不是独立的结果. 它在一个牢房上关闭大门,缝合了15秒的牢房;在锁链上的一个k ^ = 1.052\hat{k}=1.052刚刚高于最小值. 检查在fp32。 出版的KITTI和PAI-100c数发细胞是bf16运行,其零射线的精度,因此与这些细胞的精度相差少许(KITTI,2s:0.532 m). 证据所支持的比对规则的一般主张狭窄:10个标有标签的窗口纠正了一个总的尺度错误(KITTI,Waymo和Argoverse 2,43%至83%的速率和任何规则下的自负率错误),对于训练范围内的照相机来说,零射线是使用的.

blocks.zh: A.20. 可复制性细节

blocks.en: Frames are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 with area interpolation and normalised with ImageNet statistics. The speed head predicts log ⁡ ( v 0 + 0.1 ) \log(v_{0}+0.1) and is read as exp ⁡ ( ⋅ ) − 0.1 \exp(\cdot)-0.1 clamped at zero, so standstill is representable. During trajectory training the roll-out speed is the sensor speed, the displacement between the last two present poses over 0.1 s. The risk label is the teacher’s window probability. Anchors: k k -means with K = 6 K{=}6 over the training ( a , κ ) (a,\kappa) sequences, one real member per cluster, stored as a buffer; the delta layer is zero-initialised. Closest-mode loss: Huber ( β = 1 \beta{=}1 m) on the integrated x ​ y xy of the closest mode plus 0.5 cross-entropy on its index. The stitcher fuses consecutive per-window controls by inverse-variance weighting into one 10 Hz track and is trained with Huber losses on yaw and x ​ y xy of the fused track. Adapter sign conventions were checked on sequences of known turn direction. The parameter count of the released checkpoint is 1,012.2M for the backbone and 17.8M for the four heads.
blocks.zh: 框架调整为256×256 256\时,采用区域插值,并与ImageNet统计数据正常化. 速度头预测日志 QQ (v 0 + 0.1)\log (v_{0}+0}+0.1) 并读作exp QQ (⋅) − 0.1\exp (\cdot)-0.1 夹在0,所以停顿可以代表. 在轨迹训练期间,推展速度是传感器速度,最后两个场面之间的移位占地0.1秒以上。 风险标签是老师的窗口概率 。 锁定器:k-表示K=6K{=}6在训练上(a, ob) (a,\kappa)序列,每组一个真成员,存储为缓冲器;三角地层为零初始化. 闭合模式损失:Huber(β = 1\beta{=}1 m)在最接近模式的集成xy xy上加上其指数上的0.5横贯. 缝合器通过反向变量加权将连续的每扇窗控制引信装入一个10赫兹的轨迹,并在轨迹的yaw和xy上用Huber损失来训练. 在已知转弯方向的顺序上检查了适配器的签章。 已放行的检查站的参数计有:骨干1012.2M,四头17.8M.
